items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: And my band, like... It was John Collins, Harold West, Gabby(?), Chuck and myself.

ctx.x: and went to the hospital. So in the meantime, Zutty was giving everybody such a bad time, and I had just started progressing a little, getting out of the woodwork, and was (?) and "Let's get rid of Zutty" and all that. I didn't know what was going on with it.

I know when I came out, he was gone. Harold West was there. And my brother's in the band now, you know, and he's writing music, and he writes for the drums, too. He's got things they have to play. But Harold couldn't read no kind of way, you know. He was a good swinger, though. So I just told him. I said, "Look, Harold, you got the gig. While you're here, take some lessons, because sometimes we might get a job or you might have to play something outside of 'I Got Rhythm'." And he said, "Yeah," and he was supposed…

So it played out like this. We had a gig down in Stony Island. I think Stony Island is in Illinois, isn't it? Yeah. We had a night to play, a couple of nights to play, and one was an adagio dancing night. And they had some Classical music. It was very (?), but I was reading ..(?)..
